protocol: Descriptive means across groups and runs; no hypothesis testing or model selection. AR varies only sampling seed; VAE varies training and sampling seed. Training-group references are not independent tests.
assumed_alignment: 50 bp ordered 5-prime to 3-prime, positions -50 through -1; TSS +1
scan_rule: TTGACA start -35; TATAAT start -12; allow <=1 mismatch, scan radius +/-1 bp. Sensitivity uses both starts shifted -5/+5 bp and radius +/-5 bp. Paired match requires any hit in each window; it does not enforce independent spacer or validate a binding site.
